title: every measured answer resolves inside a durable root or says why it resolves nowhere
intention: Every answered question whose measured is set cites its record by a dataref address that resolves inside a durable root, or says why it resolves nowhere; each record is read before it is repointed or marked.
why: Measured 2026-11-21 (bec37ac3ae5d's scan): 34 of 319 measured answers cite a record outside this box's durable roots, and 32 do not exist here. A backfill that writes beside an answer without reading it is the failure that left 70 of 70 charters disagreeing with themselves (ticket one-mouth-answers-the-learning-question), so each is read.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured) and Law 7 (errors are permanent in records of truth)
how: For each answered question whose measured is not yet a dataref address (323 of 325, measured 2026-11-21; the first scan's 32 were only those outside a durable root, and clause 1 asks more: a box-local absolute path, a Windows path or a retired file does not resolve on every box), CC reads the answer and the cited record's lineage: the same relative path under main or the commons, or the commons ticket/outline_check of the same id. If a durable record's bytes agree with the cited one (or, where the cited bytes are gone, the durable record carries what the answer quotes), the answer is repointed to its dataref address (the old path stays in git and in the artifact journal's sha_before, never as a field: outline 0.10); otherwise it gains measured_resolves_nowhere: <why>, measured left as written. Every write rides cairn artifact write --verb answer. Outline 0.6.2 stands: questions live in the outline, and the questions/ store is deprecated. This ticket opens no question and stores none; it repairs the citations of records already answered in that deprecated store, which cairn outlinecheck still writes and the BUILDME lane the_ticket_has_every_answer_it_needs still reads (2026-11-21), so a dangling citation there is a false record of truth (Law 7).

clauses.claim: every answered question under the commons whose measured is set either resolves through Dataref to a file inside durable_roots(), or carries a non-empty measured_resolves_nowhere
every answer whose measured is a dataref address (cairn:///, cairncommons:///, instance:///) resolves through Dataref to a file, and its answered_by names that address
the scanner, over a scratch questions dir, reds a planted answer citing a missing path with no mark and one whose dataref measured names a missing file, and passes a marked one

decisions.text: D1 (clauses 1-2): the 323 question records are each read and rewritten whole through the artifact door (verb answer): 229 repointed (measured = dataref address, answered_by's measurement named anew; the old path is the journal's and git's, not a field, outline 0.10) — 123 already name the file box-locally, 105 name the same repo-relative path from a worktree, a Windows checkout or the old house path, 1 names a file 93fa3e3a6199 moved — or 94 marked (measured_resolves_nowhere = why, measured left as written): 90 cite the retired CairnComponentOutline.txt (770decaf5), 3 a cleared session scratchpad, 1 runtime state under ~/.cairn. The reading per record (kind, old, new or why, and every answer fragment the record's history does not carry, each read as an id the answer names in its own reasoning) rides the build commit as a table.
D2 (clauses 1-3): the proof scans the live questions dir read-only (marked as reading live data) through question.durable_roots() and Dataref, and a scratch dir with three planted answers.

measured.saw: 34 of 319 measured answers cite records outside the three durable roots; 32 absent on akiendelllinux
measured.how: a python scan over CairnCommons/questions/*.json, list saved at /home/akien/.akien/temp/dangling_measured_20261121.json

measured.saw: of 325 answered questions with measured set, 2 are dataref addresses, 123 box-local absolute paths that exist, 106 old paths whose record lives on in a durable root, 94 resolve nowhere (90 the retired outline file); the first scan's 32 counted only paths outside a durable root
measured.how: a python classification over CairnCommons/questions/*.json (resolved, measured set) mapping each path to its repo-relative address, and git log --follow over each target for the answer's quoted fragments and ids
